scope: Repository architecture/call-path review and targeted reliability/performance improvements

flow: Bridge step history, metric snapshots and EventRecorder spans
Node collectors/native exporters; Prometheus and Alloy/Loki
Rule diagnosis and optional LLM evidence review
JSON artifacts, show_run and Grafana investigation
reviewed_boundaries: SDK synchronous/asynchronous persistence and failure reporting
VERL follower, timing provenance and step deduplication
Collector snapshot discovery, node filtering, freshness and textfile publication
Prometheus and 3FS query budgets, baseline identity and retry scheduling
Analysis worker deadline, JSONL cache and report projection
Wrapper owned process groups and final telemetry health
Config/metric contracts, dashboard navigation tests, docs and CI
preserved: Existing backend integrations and SDK public interfaces

findings.problem: Follower remains on orphaned inode or old offset after replacement/truncation
findings.change: Reopen at EOF/partial record when inode changes or shrink is observed; replacement backlog retains unknown time
findings.baseline_reproduction: Four rotation/truncation regressions fail on baseline

findings.problem: Batch-start timestamps make later steps inherit elapsed retry time and schedule retries before analysis completion
findings.change: Record per-step attempt start and calculate next retry after completion within the original deadline
findings.baseline_reproduction: Both slow-batch regressions fail on baseline

findings.problem: Export error written to closed stderr masks workload exception or raises in background writer
findings.change: Best-effort error reporting for event and metric writers
findings.baseline_reproduction: Synchronous regression fails; asynchronous case emits unhandled-thread warnings on baseline

findings.problem: Unchanged per-worker JSON is reopened and parsed on every poll
findings.change: Metadata-validated process-local cache, bounded to 1024 files and 16 MiB of source bytes; filters/validation remain active
findings.validation: Identical collection results, expiry/deletion/rewrite/failure/overflow regressions and local benchmark

findings.problem: NaN/Infinity intervals are accepted until polling fails after side effects
findings.change: Reject nonfinite/nonpositive values in diagnosis/topology/resource CLIs before I/O
findings.validation: Nine CLI cases reject with exit code 2

baseline_regressions.note: New boundary tests run against an isolated archive of baseline; asynchronous case also emitted thread warnings

validation.lint_type_check: No standalone lint/type-check gate is configured in this repository

limitations: SDK fixture values, not VERL training.
Logical nodes share one host.
No causal storage or GPU bottleneck asserted.

benchmark.scope: local JSONL and snapshot read/parse cost
